parameters.content:
SETUP REQUIRED BEFORE ACTIVATION
• Create an n8n Header Auth credential and give it only to a trusted server-side approval endpoint.
• Connect SMTP credentials (host, port, username, password/TLS).
• Replace the sender with an address verified by your provider and recipient with an approved test mailbox or branch list.
• An `approved` flag alone is not authentication; the webhook is set to require Header Auth as an additional control.
• Keep inactive until a protected staff approval path exists and test only with a test recipient first.
